assumptions.claim: External logic must drive i_pad_256/512 and o_pad_256/512 with the correct pad values for the selected digest size (SHA-256 or SHA-512) before hash processing starts.
assumptions.cond: when the HMAC core is in operation
assumptions.risk: Using a wrong pad (e.g., SHA-512 pad in SHA-256 mode) will produce an incorrect HMAC tag, enabling integrity bypass or authentication failure.

uncertain_points.claim: Both i_pad_256 and i_pad_512 are declared, implying the core may use either pad depending on a digest size mode. The selection logic is not present in this chunk; a missing or incorrect selection could choose the wrong pad.
uncertain_points.cond: when a hash operation is started
uncertain_points.risk: If the pad for the wrong digest size is used, the resulting HMAC tag will be corrupted, potentially breaking authentication or integrity guarantees.

uncertain_points.claim: The sel_rdata_t enum includes SelFifo alongside SelIPad and SelOPad. The purpose and timing of SelFifo are unclear, and its interaction with pad data could lead to source interleaving if not properly handled.
uncertain_points.cond: when the data source select signal is active
uncertain_points.risk: Selecting the wrong source (message vs. pad) during HMAC processing could corrupt the digest computation or leak internal state.
